indicators.title: Announced M&A deal value
indicators.why: Deals are announced months before close, locking in advisory and financing fees well ahead of reported revenue.
indicators.source: LSEG Deals Intelligence monthly M&A review
indicators.note: No confirmed public time series; LSEG publishes press-release summaries only.

indicators.title: IPO pipeline — S-1 filing counts
indicators.why: Registration filings precede pricing by ~1-3 months, signaling ECM fee flow before it books.
indicators.note: EDGAR API is public but a filing-count pipeline is not yet built.

indicators.title: High-yield bond issuance
indicators.why: HY windows open and shut quickly; issuance surges/shutdowns lead DCM fees and flag shifts in credit risk appetite.
indicators.note: SIFMA publishes free research; a clean public time series is unconfirmed.

indicators.title: IB fee league-table trackers
indicators.why: Fee estimates from announced/completed deals publish weeks before banks' quarterly filings.
indicators.source: LSEG Deals Intelligence quarterly IB Review
indicators.note: Press-release summaries only; no public series.

indicators.title: MOVE Index (rates implied vol)
indicators.why: Implied Treasury vol reprices ahead of policy surprises and duration-driven deleveraging.
indicators.note: Licensed index; no free public daily series confirmed.

indicators.title: US High Yield OAS
indicators.why: HY spreads price default/liquidity risk months before realized defaults.

indicators.title: US Investment Grade OAS
indicators.why: IG spread companion to HY; investment-grade stress gauge.

indicators.title: Agency MBS spread (30Y mortgage − 30Y Treasury)
indicators.why: MBS widening signals dealer balance-sheet constraints and convexity-hedging pressure before broad funding stress.

indicators.title: WTI crude spot
indicators.why: Real-economy demand signal orthogonal to the heat map's price/stock quarterly metrics.
indicators.note: Calendar spread (prompt − 12M futures) needs a futures curve; spot is the verified public component.

indicators.title: CBOE equity put/call ratio
indicators.why: Options-positioning extremes flag crowded sentiment 1-several weeks before price turns.
indicators.note: Free historical CSV frozen at 2019-10-04; current data requires scraping the daily page.

indicators.title: Cyclically adjusted P/E vs 10-yr mean
indicators.why: Starting valuation is the most robust predictor of medium-horizon returns.
indicators.note: Yale file unreachable/stale as of 2026-10; no confirmed current public series.

indicators.title: US IPO + follow-on issuance volume
indicators.why: Treasurers time equity supply to peak demand; issuance surges cluster near cycle tops.
indicators.note: Free charts; a clean public time series is unconfirmed.

indicators.title: High-beta minus low-vol 60-day relative strength
indicators.why: Rotations into high-beta leadership precede broad index turns as late-cycle risk appetite peaks.
indicators.note: Needs a reliable free ETF price feed; tested sources are bot-walled.

segments.title: Asset & Wealth Management
segments.subtitle: Flows, cash parking, market beta, private markets

indicators.title: Net flows to long-term mutual funds & ETFs
indicators.why: Redemption/allocation shifts move AUM and fee bases weeks before reported revenue.
indicators.note: ICI publishes weekly Excel workbooks; direct download URL unconfirmed (page is bot-walled).

indicators.title: Money-market fund total assets
indicators.why: Sharp MMF inflows signal flight-to-cash and liquidity hoarding, presaging risk-asset outflows.

indicators.title: S&P 500 level
indicators.why: Market beta drives most AUM change; drawdowns lead AUM erosion and fee declines.

indicators.title: 3M CP–OIS spread
indicators.why: CP is the marginal unsecured funding market; spreads reprice within days as risk appetite erodes.
indicators.source: Constructed: Fed commercial paper rates − 3M OIS
indicators.note: No confirmed public 3M OIS series; spread cannot be built from verified inputs.

indicators.title: 3M×3M FRA–OIS spread
indicators.why: Prices forward unsecured term-funding risk plus embedded bank counterparty credit.
indicators.note: No free public feed confirmed.

indicators.title: FINRA margin debt (debit balances)
indicators.why: Client leverage builds/unwinds ahead of forced deleveraging; peaks precede volatility cascades.

indicators.title: Dealer 5Y senior CDS (average)
indicators.why: Market-implied default intensity of counterparties widens before CVA losses or rating actions.
indicators.note: No free public feed confirmed.

segments.title: Funding Plumbing
segments.subtitle: Overnight funding, settlement, and wholesale liquidity

indicators.title: SOFR–IORB spread
indicators.why: The spread of overnight secured funding to the Fed's administered rate is the corridor's thermometer: when SOFR sits below IORB, reserves are abundant and cash is seeking alternatives.
indicators.note: IORB starts 2021-07-29, which limits the backfill.

indicators.title: ON RRP take-up
indicators.why: Cash parked in the Fed's overnight reverse repo facility is cash not funding markets; a collapse toward zero means cash is no longer seeking the Fed's balance sheet, i.e. reserves are no longer abundant.

indicators.title: Primary dealer fails-to-deliver
indicators.why: Fails-to-deliver spike when Treasury settlement chains seize — the observable footprint of settlement stress in the world's deepest market.
indicators.source: NY Fed primary-dealer statistics (11 Treasury fails-to-deliver series, summed)
indicators.note: Sum of 11 Treasury fails-to-deliver codes (-TD); values of "*" are suppressed below the confidentiality threshold and treated as 0.

indicators.title: FHLB advances
indicators.why: Federal Home Loan Bank advances are banks' wholesale funding tap of first resort when deposits flee — a surge flags liquidity stress before it reaches the discount window.
indicators.source: FHLB Office of Finance Combined Financial Reports (CFR)
indicators.note: Parsed from CFR PDFs (MD&A advances figure). Older CFRs live under different URL paths and are not chased, so the series covers the quarters the current URL pattern reaches (2025Q2 onward as of 2026-10); unpublished quarters are skipped.

indicators.title: Treasury cash–futures basis (proxy)
indicators.why: A wider (more positive) basis means cash Treasuries cheapen relative to futures — the classic footprint of dealer balance-sheet constraints.
indicators.source: Computed: FRED DGS10 minus Yahoo ZN=F implied yield
indicators.note: Proxy: futures-implied yield of a hypothetical 6%-coupon 10-year note at the quoted futures price. Abstracts from the cheapest-to-deliver option, delivery timing, and repo financing effects.

indicators.title: EUR/USD cross-currency basis (CIP construction)
indicators.why: A negative basis means synthetic dollar funding via EUR costs more than direct dollars — the offshore dollar-shortage thermometer.
indicators.source: Constructed: CME Euro FX futures + FRED DEXUSEU, DGS3MO, IR3TIB01EZM156N (Du–Tepper–Verdelhan)
indicators.note: Experimental DIY construction; EUR leg only; series starts 2025-04 (Yahoo delists expired futures contracts). The FRED Euribor input is stale and the T-bill leg is not banks' marginal funding rate — watch changes, not levels.

segments.title: Positioning & Microstructure
segments.subtitle: Who is crowded, and where prices detach from fundamentals

indicators.title: Speculative rate-futures z-scores
indicators.why: Leveraged-fund net positioning at extremes has preceded sharp rate repricings — crowded trades unwind violently.
indicators.note: Four contracts (UST 2Y/5Y/10Y notes, 3M SOFR): leveraged-fund net (long − short) z-scored against its trailing 104-week window, current week excluded.

indicators.title: Corporate bond ETF dislocation (proxy)
indicators.why: An ETF trading far below its own recent average price is the observable footprint of a price/NAV dislocation (e.g. March 2020, when LQD/HYG traded at steep discounts and mean-reverted).
indicators.source: Yahoo Finance: LQD, HYG vs trailing 20-day mean
indicators.note: Proxy: (close − 20d MA) / 20d MA. The true (market price − NAV)/NAV leg is not published in machine-readable form — documented as a proxy, not the accounting discount.

indicators.title: Excess Bond Premium (CDS–bond basis proxy)
indicators.why: The excess bond premium isolates the non-default (liquidity/funding) component of corporate spreads — exactly what the CDS–bond basis measures (Bai & Collin-Dufresne, 2019).
indicators.source: Federal Reserve FEDS Notes EBP series (Gilchrist–Zakrajšek methodology)
indicators.note: Direction matches dealer-quoted basis (spikes when funding stress widens it); levels are NOT comparable to dealer CDS quotes — compare deviations/spikes, not absolute levels.

indicators.title: Bank insider net selling
indicators.why: Insiders sell ahead of bad news more often than they buy ahead of good — persistent net open-market selling by bank officers is a sentiment gauge for the sector.
indicators.source: OpenInsider (SEC Form 4 filings): JPM, BAC, C, WFC, GS, MS, USB, PNC
indicators.note: Each ticker page lists only recent transactions, so the trailing ~12 months are the usable window. Amendments/duplicates are not de-duplicated — treat the level as approximate, the month-to-month changes as the signal.

segments.title: Filings & Behavior
segments.subtitle: What banks report and what they say

indicators.title: Bank HTM unrealized losses
indicators.why: Unrealized losses on held-to-maturity securities are the unrealized-capital hole that forced sales crystallize — the SVB lesson in aggregate.
indicators.source: FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile (QBP), aggregate workbook
indicators.note: Balance-sheet row "Held to maturity on non-equity securities unrealized gain/loss"; reported as gain/loss in $ millions (losses negative), sign-flipped so positive values are losses.

indicators.title: MMF repo counterparty concentration
indicators.why: Repo is the marginal funding market; when a handful of dealers dominate money-fund repo, a single counterparty wobble propagates.
indicators.source: SEC DERA Form N-MFP monthly data sets
indicators.note: Top-3 dealer share ≈ 27.13% under the verified methodology (sponsored-repo rows attributed to the named sponsor dealer; residual unmapped volume excluded from the dealer ranking) — supersedes the earlier 14.6% print, which used a different attribution.

indicators.title: Bank earnings-call credit language
indicators.why: Management language on credit quality, reserves, and provisions shifts before the charge-offs show up in the numbers.
indicators.source: Motley Fool earnings-call transcripts (JPM, BAC, WFC)
indicators.note: v1 methodology proof, not a production time series: verified on Q3 2026 calls (JPM 7.6 / BAC 11.6 / WFC 8.9 per 10k words); the framework caught JPMorgan's actual $539m reserve build.

segments.title: Cross-Market
segments.subtitle: Commodity term structure as a real-economy gauge

indicators.title: WTI calendar spread (prompt−12M)
indicators.why: Backwardation means a tight physical market and low inventories; contango means glut. The slope of the curve is the physical market's stress gauge.
indicators.source: Yahoo Finance: CL=F front month minus the contract expiring ~12 months later
indicators.note: Trailing ~12 months of history only — Yahoo delists expired contracts, so the 12M leg exists only where the contract is still listed.
